title: Phase 1 Discovery — final desktop and mobile

MobileStates.dc.html.title: M4 · A failure on the phone

q1.text: Open: does the per-database retrieval cap move into a protocol field (target_candidate_pool_size semantics, SRCH-31), or stay a plan setting with no cap by default? D2 shows 2,000 as a plan limit.

q2.text: Open: is the recall check a hard gate, or advisory with 'Run anyway, 1 missed' recorded in the report (as drawn on D3)?

q3.text: Open: can the corpus be accepted with near-twin pairs still undecided (drawn: they stay separate and are listed), or must every pair be decided first?

q4.text: Open: how long may a cached provider response be reused before a run must refetch? A cache hit carries its original fetch date into the report (D4, D7).

q5.text: Open: is the contact email stored per workspace or per installation, and is it written into the run manifest (it is personal data)?

q6.text: Open: in PRISMA-S, is an imported Scopus or Web of Science export reported as its own database row (as drawn on D5 and D7), and must the export's own limits be recorded?

q7.text: Open: the typed codes on D4, D5, D8 and M4 (PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED, CAP_REACHED, CONTACT_EMAIL_MISSING, IMPORT_LINE_REJECTED, ENGINE_UNREACHABLE, ...) are proposals; confirm the code list before the specs are marked FINAL.

decided.text: Decided in this pass: web app on localhost, terminal only as a secondary disclosure. Each database's executed string is shown verbatim and run exactly as written, no rewrite, with reported total vs fetched, cap flag (count is a lower bound), cache hit and UTC date. Providers: OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar (needs a key, else off), Crossref, arXiv, PubMed; bioRxiv off by default because it cannot evaluate NOT/Boolean. Contact email is a required setting, no placeholder address. RIS/CSV imports carry database name, search date and the query run there. Record ids stay stable across re-runs. Near-twins are your decision (Merge / Keep both), journaled with you, HUMAN, time and protocol fingerprint; undo supersedes. Methods text is a draft until you mark it reviewed. Phone: monitoring and near-twin decisions only, queued when offline.

parked.text: Not production: Full text, Synthesis, Matrix, Graph and Trust appear struck through in the phase stepper with a 'Not production' marker. Scopus and Web of Science have no connection; they come in only as imported exports.
